title: ADT: All-Atom Diffusion Tokenizer for 3D Molecular Structures
abstract: arXiv:2610.23265v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Discrete structural tokenization provides a promising route to autoregressive 3D molecular generation. Yet, existing tokenizers face a trade-off between compact representation and all-atom reconstruction: atom-level tokens preserve atomic details but produce long sequences, while compact residue-level protein tokens typically omit side-chain geometry. To overcome this limitation, we propose All-atom Diffusion Tokenizer (ADT), which decouples token granularity from reconstruction resolution. ADT uses one structural token per atom for small molecules and one token per protein residue that jointly represents backbone and side-chain geometry. To mitigate geometric distortion introduced by quantization, we leverage the generative capacity of diffusion models to recover fine-grained atomic geometry beyond deterministic decoding from discrete tokens. translated_title: ADT：面向三维分子结构的全原子扩散分词器
translated_abstract: 离散结构分词为自回归式三维分子生成提供了一条有前景的路径。然而，现有分词器在紧凑表示与全原子重建之间存在权衡：原子级分词能够保留原子细节，但会产生较长的序列；而紧凑的残基级蛋白质分词通常会忽略侧链几何信息。为克服这一局限，我们提出了全原子扩散分词器，它将分词粒度与重建分辨率解耦。ADT对小分子采用每个原子一个结构分词的方式，对蛋白质则采用每个残基一个分词来联合表示主链和侧链的几何信息。为减轻量化过程引入的几何畸变，我们利用扩散模型的生成能力，超越基于离散分词的确定性解码，从而恢复细粒度的原子几何结构。在小分子和蛋白质上的大量实验表明，ADT实现了强大的……
tldr: ADT通过将分词粒度与重建分辨率解耦，并借助扩散模型的生成能力恢复量化带来的几何畸变，实现了兼顾紧凑表示与全原子精确保建的三维分子结构分词方法。
en_tdlr: ADT decouples token granularity from reconstruction resolution and leverages diffusion models to recover geometric distortions caused by quantization, achieving compact yet all-atom-faithful tokenization of 3D molecular structures.
